rules.source: Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022 (Sri Lanka) — https://dpa.gov.lk/Background.php
rules.retrieved_snippet: Fetched from the Data Protection Authority site: "Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022", "passed by the Sri Lankan Parliament on 19th March 2022"; phased commencement: Part V on 17 July 2023, Parts VI, VIII, IX, X on 1 December 2023, Parts I, II, III, VII scheduled for 18 March 2025 (search summary: a 2025 amendment reportedly changes remaining commencement to ministerial order; unverified).

rules.source: Computer Crime Act No. 24 of 2007 (Sri Lanka) — https://documents.gov.lk/view/acts/2007/7/24-2007_E.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary only (fetch of the PDF returned 404): the Act is hosted at documents.gov.lk and lawnet.gov.lk; it covers unauthorised computer access and making devices/passwords available for offences, with fines and imprisonment up to three years, and has extraterritorial reach where the computer, service or loss is connected to Sri Lanka.

rules.source: Online Safety Act No. 9 of 2024 (Sri Lanka) — https://www.srilankalaw.lk/bulletin/bulletin-2024/3203-act-9-of-2024-online-safety-act.html
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary only (secondary sources: srilankalaw.lk, readme.lk, Wikipedia; official text not retrieved): Parliament passed the Act on 24 January 2024, in effect early February 2024 (sources differ 1 vs 2 Feb); creates an Online Safety Commission; false-statement offences in ss.12-20, online child-abuse offences s.21, bot conduct s.22.
